note: Directory-wide mail capture (owner directive c75dfaba0f8e; integrations/mail_directory_scope.py): every member user mailbox of the tenant directory, listed through the guarded, paged GET /users, except (1) every excluded person (PLX_EXCLUDED_PEOPLE_OIDS / PLX_EXCLUDED_PEOPLE_FILE through integrations/people_exclusion.py; unset or empty, the run refuses before any request) and (2) the HR / payroll deny list below. Both are dropped before any request names the mailbox. Inbox and sent items, 90-day first round, then delta; the store stays under PLX_WORKBENCH_STATE_DIR. No person, address or object id is named here.

deny.reason: HR and payroll mail holds employee personal, compensation and health data outside the Workbench's purpose; Vince's grant covers business mailboxes, not these. A mailbox is denied when a local part of any of its addresses (or one of its . _ - + separated tokens, or the local part without separators) is an address token, or its directory department contains a listed department as whole words.
